book.title: Gelindo Kunlade Huaisan Ji 1 Hui Xin

content: Bi chenliese shuhuajia tai dunda lon kijieku shiqin wine. Intu shiqin niman kunlai dundaliuzhe uwo. Nie kun goya khuitu anarene kijiezho.
Ta dou goyalane fugiede uzhene. Ta indan hende nango giekui wo. Ene shiqinni giesan kunni tai dundase tou khighakui wo!
Mii kun tanre hhantu uwoma, zhughemi tanre hhantu wo. Bi tai hhende bisan mutun intu shiqinyi giesan kunyi Ezhan Ersai niereghala ijin zui jinjiwo.
Ta hhantulazhi mii zhughe tanre hhantu bikude mai Ezhan Ersani qienlighala
intu kunni Ibiliside jiuizhi beyeni huailugha gie, ingiese ruhheryini Ezhanni udude jiuine.
Ta goyalane kuaise ese oluzho. Goujinie kunieghe nie duizi ghurunni man faighakui ta ulie mejienu?
Tashi tanmien woshi khuichen kunieghei widaghadene shini ghurun gholu. Matanyi Jiulidaosan Jieni ghoni ghughan yeshijiu Mexihai ijin zharuzhi sidagha giewo.
Ingiese matan jieqi daoghase doghun, mouxientu khuichen kuniegheghala bu daoghadene ganjin, shixintu tanmienghala daoghaye.
Bi eqighandei tande xin huaizhi ta lon kijiechen kunlare laiwon bu gie giezhi kieliewo.
Mii isishi ene duyadedu lon kijiechen, tanxin giechen, piendachen, nigiedai beiichen kunlare jiedui laiwon bu gie giekui pusho. Qingiese ta ene duyase likai giese da gou wo.

Ede bi ene xinni tande huaikushi goyaneshi xianxin giesan gaijiu wo giedene lon kijiesan, tanxin giesan, nigiedai beiisan, kun sugiesan, jiu ochisan, piendasan intui giesan kunlare ta laiwon bu giezhi budanye hhantu bu ijie giezho.
Ghadanedu kunyi bi kheilaku pushoma, sudorodu kunyi ta kheilaku pushonu?
Ghadanedu kunyi Huda panjine. "Ta dundasene mouxien kunlai tou khigha."
